description: DRC about LT+MT MCTS node 34 (root_node34.json): every temperature inside 10 % of Lin except 900 K (+16.7 %). Same design as the LT+MT DRC so the two compare directly: all 20 directions (16 reactions + 4 sticking coefficients), +-0.3 e-folds, 144 CRN-paired replicates, 900-1150 K. Purpose: measure, at the point we would move from, which parameter lowers 900 K without lowering 925-1150 K (WHY.txt).
